name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch

instructions.description: Stand holding a chair or a wall for support, then take a full step back with one foot.
Gently tuck the pelvis and shift weight forward.
Keep the rear heel lifted and trunk upright.
Return and repeat with the other leg behind.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Use support and a small pelvic tuck.

variations.variationDescription: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.
